instruction: Candid outdoor photograph, medium shot. In a sunny park, a group of children pose together during a warm group hug. A girl in a light pink sweater (R6) wearing a white headband stands in the center holding purple wrapped gifts, smiling directly towards the camera. She is embraced from the left by a smiling girl in a dark blue top (R4) and from the right by a boy in a yellow t-shirt (R1) wearing glasses and a striped party hat. Behind them, a boy with short brown hair (R5) wearing a blue denim shirt and a party hat smiles. Bright, warm sunlight illuminates the green trees in the background, casting a soft glow over the happy scene.
elements: R1 embraces R6 from one side while R6 holds the gifts
R4 embraces R6 from the other side while R6 holds the gifts
R6 is the central child being embraced by R1 and R4 while holding purple wrapped gifts
R5 stands behind the central embraced group and smiles
The scene is a sunny park with green trees in the background
